assistant-memory.what: Choose how much the bot remembers of your conversation.

assistant-forget.what: Have the bot forget your conversation now; what you put on a list stays.

weekOverview.what: Show your week: chores, appointments, shopping. Or one day.

sendWeekOverview.what: The bot sends you the overview of your week on Sunday.

assistant-feedback.what: Say where feedback about the app goes.

announceChange.what: The bot tells whoever it concerns that an appointment or chore changed.

assistant-reminders.what: Switch your reminders on or off, or choose when they come.

remindMe.what: Set a reminder of your own: at a time, for an appointment or chore, or for everyone.

params.rules: when, for example 60 minutes before or morning

sayReminder.what: The bot says your reminder at its moment.

cancelReminder.what: Remove a reminder of your own.

params.which: its number in /gepland, or a word

assistant-quiet.what: Choose your own quiet hours, or the household's.

assistant-overview.what: Switch the Sunday overview on or off.

assistant-language.what: Choose the language the bot answers you in.

params.lang: Dutch, English, or as you write

assistant-apps.what: Switch an app for the household on or off.

assistant-settings.what: Show the settings of the whole household, or change one.

assistant-role.what: Change someone's role in the household.

assistant-status.what: Show how the bot is doing.

assistant-usage.what: Show what the model cost this month.

assistant-users.what: Show who is in the household.

assistant-planned.what: Show what the bot will send you this week.

assistant-people.what: Show who is in this household, with their role.

assistant-cohort.what: Make a code several people can join with.

params.spec: how many people, how many days

assistant-invite.what: Make a code one person can join with.

assistant-rotate.what: Replace the codes; the old ones stop working.

assistant-circle.what: Put the bot in a circle, or take it out.

assistant-circles.what: Show the circles the bot is in.

assistant-revoke.what: Take someone out of the household.

assistant-view.what: Choose how the bot answers: with buttons, on your screen or in words.

assistant-agenda-link.what: Make a link to your agenda, for your calendar app; the previous one stops working.

assistant-screen.what: Connect a screen, so you work with the bot there.

params.how: with a link or a code

assistant-screen-paste.what: Connect a screen with its own connect code.

assistant-screen-confirm.what: Pick the code of a screen that wants to connect.

assistant-export-key-set.what: Set the export key: your passphrase, on your screen only.

assistant-export-key-unlock.what: Open the export key for an hour, to restore an export.

assistant-link.what: Link your Basis app to yourself.

assistant-link-confirm.what: Pick the code your Basis app shows.

assistant-inapp.what: Put the household in your own app too.

assistant-companion.what: Give the bot the household's companion, for the agenda links.

assistant-screen-approve.what: Say yes or no to what a screen asked.

assistant-screens.what: Show your connected screens, or disconnect one.
